test_hydra_main_decorator: test the hydra_main decorator to wrap a main function with Hydra config and Dora experiment management
test_hydra_get_xp: test HydraMain.get_xp to create an XP object from a list of command-line argument overrides
test_hydra_value_to_argv: test HydraMain.value_to_argv to convert a Python dict of config overrides into Hydra argv strings
test_hydra_get_xp_from_sig: test HydraMain.get_xp_from_sig to retrieve a previously run XP object by its unique signature hash
test_hydra_get_xp_history: test HydraMain.get_xp_history to retrieve the list of pushed metrics for a given XP experiment
